description:
Low Poly model of a computer desk, optimized for the game engine.

The archive contains several models:
- Two books
- Office chair
- Ceramic mug
- Computer desk
- Desk lamp
- Keyboard
- Two audio speakers (one with volume control)
- Monitor
- Mouse
- Stationery cup containing: scissors, a pencil and two different pens

All models have PBR textures. Metallic/Roughness.

Texture resolution:

Books: 512x256

office chair: 2048x2048

Ceramic mug: 512x256

Computer desk: 4096x4096

Table lamp: 1024x1024

Keyboard: 256x512

Audio speakers: 512x512

Monitor: 1024x1024

Mouse: 256x512

Stationery glass, scissors, pencil and pens (have a common texture): 512x512

All models consist of a triangular grid.

Number of polygons in the scene: 12,548

Number of vertices in the scene: 7005

All models are made in Blender 3.1.2
previewKind: Author thumbnail; not imported or tested in Unity
